The execution failed due to significant numerical discrepancies in campaign margins and total annual margin calculations.
The test_rows_and_order failed with 'close(468.0, 7956.0)' returning False, indicating a logic error in campaign-level cost-benefit math. Additionally, test_totals_and_decision failed with 'close(-45894.84, -83406.84)', showing a large variance in the final aggregated annual margin. The failures occurred in /tests/test_outputs.py during the pytest execution within the harbor environment.
